transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past eight months. It has been incredibly hard to get through each day when everything just feels so heavy and blank.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger? If there was a stressor, is it still going on?
I honestly can't point to any specific stressful event or trigger that started all of this. It just seemed to happen out of nowhere without any clear cause.
Before these past eight months, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years, even if it was milder? Or did this depression begin only within the last eight months?
No, I didn't have any long-term feelings of depression before this. It only started about eight months ago, and I wasn't feeling down or sad in the years leading up to it.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, spending time with people, or everyday activities?

I haven't really experienced a loss of interest in my hobbies or the things I usually enjoy. Instead, I've just been feeling incredibly sad, empty, and emotionally numb most of the time. It's more about those heavy feelings than losing interest in things.
During these eight months, have you had changes in sleep, appetite or weight, energy, concentration, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness?

Yes, my appetite has decreased significantly and I've lost a lot of weight over these past eight months. I haven't really noticed major changes in my sleep, concentration, or feelings of guilt. It's mostly just been the lack of appetite alongside that constant, heavy feeling of sadness and emptiness.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?

Yes, I've been having really dark thoughts quite often over these past eight months. I frequently find myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up, and I get scary, sudden urges to end my life because the despair feels so unbearable.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked faster, or acted more impulsively than usual?

Yes, I actually did have a period like that for about a week where I felt incredibly energetic and euphoric. I barely felt the need to rest and ended up starting multiple projects at once while spending a ton of money on reckless buying sprees.
During that unusually energetic period, did you have hallucinations, hear or see things others didn’t, or strongly believe things that others said weren’t true?

Yes, during that week I heard voices whispering to me that no one else could hear, and I was convinced that I had special powers and people were watching me. These strange experiences only happened during that high-energy phase and completely went away once it ended.
Outside of that high-energy period, have you ever had hallucinations or strong unusual beliefs when your mood was normal or depressed?

No, I have never experienced any hallucinations or unusual beliefs outside of that high-energy period. Those experiences only happened during that specific week, and never when my mood was normal or depressed.
